name: GitAgent
tagline: An agent that searches, refactors, comments and documents a GitHub repository and writes its Dockerfile.

awards: Build an AI agent with Cohere

solution: An agent with semantic code search automates refactoring, commenting, README and Dockerfile generation on a connected repository.
demo_moment: Team-described: ask where a feature lives, then generate its README.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Third Place: Digital Camera” and “[MLH] Best Use of GenAI” and “Build an AI agent with Cohere” among 134 submissions.
A solo builder placed third and won two AI prizes.

lessons: One agent, several concrete chores, shown on a real repository.
